about: What AIPLAY Studio Setup.exe unpacks from this repository's main branch. Everything else in the repository (docs, examples, the website's banners, notes) never reaches an install. Add a line here when a new top-level folder or file is needed at run time; the installer reads this file from the zip it downloads, so it never has to be rebuilt for it. `preserve` names folders in the app that hold the person's own files (custom workflows, a clone of the GPL Blender toolkit): a reinstall or an update copies them across instead of replacing them.
